name: Mesmerboa
look: a floating big-eared yellow jerboa with a gentle smile, huge red-rimmed white ears and a tail curled into a great turning yellow-and-violet ring round it, ending in a big zigzag lightning bolt
entry: Its tail is so long it never touches the ground: it hangs round Mesmerboa in a great ring that crackles with electricity. Spun fast, the ring can put a whole herd of Pokémon to sleep at once.
how: Use a Thunder Stone on Jerbolt. It learns Psychic Noise when it evolves.
Wild: rare in deserts at night.
